name: Análise IA de Gastos Semanais
description: Analisa padrões de gasto com Gemini IA e gera recomendações personalizadas de planos.

parameters.query:
SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM spending_logs
WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
AND user_id NOT IN (
  SELECT user_id FROM spending_analysis 
  WHERE period_month = DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE)
)

WITH spending_data AS (
  SELECT 
    operation_type,
    COUNT(*) as count,
    SUM(estimated_cost) as total_cost,
    EXTRACT(HOUR FROM created_at) as hour_of_day,
    EXTRACT(DOW FROM created_at) as day_of_week
  FROM spending_logs
  WHERE user_id = '{{ $json.user_id }}'
  AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
  GROUP BY operation_type, hour_of_day, day_of_week
)
SELECT 
  '{{ $json.user_id }}'::uuid as user_id,
  CURRENT_DATE as analysis_date,
  (
    SELECT json_object_agg(operation_type, count) 
    FROM spending_data
  ) as operation_breakdown,
  (
    SELECT json_object_agg(hour_of_day, total_cost) 
    FROM spending_data 
    WHERE hour_of_day IS NOT NULL
  ) as hourly_distribution,
  (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_cost), 0) 
    FROM spending_data
  ) as total_cost,
  (
    SELECT COUNT(*) 
    FROM spending_logs 
    WHERE user_id = '{{ $json.user_id }}'
    AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
  ) as total_requests

INSERT INTO spending_analysis (
  user_id,
  period_month,
  total_cost,
  total_requests,
  usage_pattern,
  ai_insights,
  ai_recommendations,
  predicted_monthly_cost,
  saving_opportunity,
  generated_at
) VALUES (
  '{{ $json.user_id }}',
  DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE)::date,
  {{ $json.total_cost }},
  {{ $json.total_requests }},
  '{{ json.stringify($json.operation_breakdown) }}'::jsonb,
  '{{ $json.content[0].parts[0].text.match(/\"insight\":\s*\"([^\"]*)\"/)?.[1] || "Análise em processamento" }}',
  '{{ $json.content[0].parts[0].text.match(/\"recommendation\":\s*\"([^\"]*)\"/)?.[1] || "Recomendação em processamento" }}',
  {{ $json.content[0].parts[0].text.match(/\"predicted_monthly_cost\":\s*(\d+\.?\d*)/)?.[1] || $json.total_cost * 4 }},
  {{ $json.content[0].parts[0].text.match(/\"saving_opportunity\":\s*(\d+\.?\d*)/)?.[1] || 0 }},
  NOW()
)
RETURNING *
SELECT * FROM email_templates WHERE name = 'monthly_report' LIMIT 1

SELECT u.email, u.user_metadata->>'name' as name
FROM auth.users u
WHERE u.id = '{{ $json.user_id }}'

INSERT INTO email_queue (
  user_id,
  recipient_email,
  template_id,
  type,
  priority,
  variables,
  status,
  scheduled_for
) VALUES (
  '{{ $json.user_id }}',
  '{{ $json.email }}',
  '{{ $json.id }}',
  'monthly_report',
  2,
  '{{ json.stringify({
    month: "Janeiro 2026",
    total_requests: $json.total_requests,
    cost: ($json.total_cost || 0).toFixed(2),
    savings: ($json.saving_opportunity || 0).toFixed(2),
    ai_insight: $json.ai_insights,
    recommendation: $json.ai_recommendations,
    dashboard_url: "https://fitcoach.com/dashboard"
  }) }}'::jsonb,
  'pending',
  NOW()
)
RETURNING *
